Specification: This module is a thin wrapper around another specification, intended to provide Apalache-oriented type annotations and a concrete message set for an instantiated inner FIFO channel model. It declares channel-like variables `in` and `out` together with a queue variable `q`, instantiates `InnerFIFOInstanced`, and defines a concrete constant value set `MessageVal`. It also defines `ChannelTypeInvariants` as the conjunction of two imported channel type invariant operators, while explicitly avoiding the original unbounded queue type invariant check mentioned in the comments.
